other_failure_modes.name: Reference copy bug in state_dict on CPU
other_failure_modes.description: When saving the best weights, `v.cpu()` does not create a copy if the tensor is already on the CPU. Thus, if the script falls back to CPU execution, `best_weights` retains references to the active model parameters and gets overwritten as training continues, effectively losing the best weights.
other_failure_modes.evidence: best_weights = {k: v.cpu() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}
